periods.summary: After Lux falls asleep in the corridor, Philuffy brings him to her room and sleeps in the same lower bunk, causing a misunderstanding when Tillfur enters in the morning.
periods.cause: Lux has no assigned room and collapses from exhaustion after the welcome party.
periods.process: Philuffy finds him in the hallway, carries him to her lower bunk because the upper bunk is too troublesome, and Tillfur discovers them in the morning.
periods.outcome: Lux, Philuffy, and Tillfur all end up late.
periods.aftermath: Lux becomes Philuffy's temporary roommate, increasing intimacy and academy gossip.
periods.significance: Establishes Lux's living arrangement and Philuffy's unchanged childhood intimacy toward him.
